source.original_title: 05/12/2026 - Jacob Gaines & Farooq Bey KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session
source.display_title: 05/12/2026 - Jacob Gaines & Farooq Bey KFS- Kettlebell Body Game Plan Session — Follow Up

prospect.name: Dylan
prospect.occupation: Safety and Training Specialist with a water utility, working on OSHA and EPA compliance
prospect.family_status: Has children — 'I only have so much of like a time ability with the kids'. Refers to consulting 'my fam' before purchasing.
prospect.training_background: Boxing and jiu-jitsu, with some marathon running. Returned to jiu-jitsu in the last couple of months after a knee problem. Has been saving Trevor's YouTube videos and assembling his own kettlebell programme. A jiu-jitsu black belt previously encouraged him toward kettlebells. Prefers bench press and carrying weights.
prospect.medical: Two knee injuries. One knee has been 'messed up since last November', roughly six months, which kept him out of jiu-jitsu until recently. He injured the other knee during marathon running. Both were volunteered in a single sentence and neither was asked about, so severity, diagnosis and current status are unknown.

signals: Proposed label: the_self_assembler — a self-directed prospect who builds his own programme from free content, is repeatedly derailed by injury rather than by motivation, and applies for coaching to find out what he does not know rather than because he has decided to buy
Assembles his own training from saved free videos — 'I've been saving those videos and making my own program for kettlebells'
Default assumption of self-sufficiency, softening — 'I've kind of just thought I could always figure it out on my own... And yeah, I suppose that hasn't worked out'
Not skeptical_bargain_hunter, because his cheap alternative demonstrably did not work; not the_rebuilder, because he references no former self, only years of unsuccessful attempts
Genuinely uncertain what he was even applying for — 'I didn't really know it was all involved' and 'I'm trying to figure it out'

goals.text: Lose weight — named as the primary goal, for health
Overall better fitness and functional strength
Get onto a structured kettlebell programme designed for his goals so he can stick to it — 'Maybe if I had a set program, you know, designed for what my goals are, I could keep to it a little better'

pains.text: Years of unsuccessful weight loss attempts — 'I've been trying to lose weight for years now. I just, not very good at it, I guess'
Repeated injuries interrupt training — one knee out since last November, the other injured through marathon running — 'as I get injured, I kind of get out of it for a little bit'
Cannot hold to a diet — 'I kind of have not been as true to a certain diet as I would like'
Does not know whether what he is doing is right — 'I don't know if I've been doing the right stuff or the right diet'
Limited time because of the children
Training that did not deliver — marathon running 'didn't really help me lose too much weight, honestly, I don't know what the deal was with that'

offer.payment_plan_terms: Primal University presented at $200/month, framed as effectively a one-off $200 purchase on the basis it can be cancelled after a month.

evidence: The one-to-one coaching offer was never presented and no coaching price was ever stated, despite the prospect having specifically applied for one-to-one — 'I also clicked on this apply for a one-on-one'

Rep pre-emptively routed him away from coaching on impression rather than qualification: 'I'm not sure if you're in the boat yet where one-on-one... coaching, having Trevor's, like, complete handholding for a year is where you're at, just from the vibe'
Did not purchase the $200 product on the call — 'If you put the link in the chat, I'll check it out when I get home and run it by my fam and make sure that I want to do that'
Rep agreed to email the link rather than process anything live, so no payment link was actioned and no verbal commitment was given
Counter-evidence on intent: he was warm throughout and open to the modality — 'No, I'm willing to try it for sure'
outcome.next_step: Rep to email the Primal University link; prospect to review it at home and discuss with his family.

notable.note: Two separate and unrelated sales calls share this one file — this one with Dylan, then a second with Jacob Gaines from 00:16:24 onward. The title names only Jacob. Two things stand out on Dylan's call. First, he applied specifically for one-to-one coaching and the offer was never presented to him; the rep diverted him to the $200 self-serve product on the basis of 'the vibe', without asking a single question about budget, and Dylan never learned what coaching costs. Second, he disclosed two injured knees, one persisting since November, and was asked nothing about either before being pointed at a loaded kettlebell programme. He also twice asked whether the programme is customised to him and never got a straight answer, then said he would be 'more interested' precisely because he believed it could be customised. To the rep's credit he refused to run the call while the prospect was driving, and gave a clear recording disclosure when asked.

quality.notes: Two prospects and two calls in one file under three labels, with a gap around 00:14:13 to 00:16:24 where the rep is heard phoning the next prospect. Within Dylan's portion the labels invert frequently — 'Live stream? Yeah. I can't see' and the whole recording-disclosure explanation are split across both labels, and the rep's questions 'Why do you feel like you haven't been successful?' and 'Do you feel like what I've shown you there would help you though?' sit correctly while surrounding turns do not. Prospect's surname is never spoken and cannot be recovered, as the title belongs to the other call. Several garbled passages.
